updates.note: Ethan's answer: how it started (batch A8)

notes: Photographed on October 25, 2026, on the porch shelf.

Photographed on October 25, 2026, on the porch shelf. It started with at least five larger leaves without holes; an animal ate them all some months before October 2026, and these fenestrated leaves are the regrowth. It had no tag.
id_basis: Heart-shaped young leaves that already have holes near the midrib and notches at the edge, the way young Monstera deliciosa leaves begin. The shoots come up from an old knot of roots, so it is probably regrowing from a stem cutting or an older plant that was cut back.

Monstera deliciosa can do that when it regrows from an established stem and roots.
